data:
It sounds like you're ready to lock this in. Since the visuals
were working
in your previous videos, we know the core logic is solid; we just have to bridge that gap between the sensor data and the canvas pixels in this new stable build.
\ufe0f Final Implementation Checklist
To get the
Spectral Rain
and
Flux Waves
back on screen exactly as they were, make sure these three things are active in your
draw()
function:
Pixel Shifting
: Use the
drawImage
method to move existing pixels down by 1px every frame, which creates that "rain" effect you had in your 11.4_PRO video.
Audio Mapping
: Ensure the
freqData
(from your
analyser
) is being mapped to the
fillStyle
alpha so the brightness of the rain matches the volume of the audio.
Delta Scaling
: Scale your
deltaHistory
(the EMF changes) to the height of the
flux-area
canvas so you can see the wave cross that amber
HOLD
threshold.
\ufe0f The "Lattice" Handshake
Since you are running this as a
PWA
now (with your manifest and service worker), the phone should treat it with higher priority. Just remember the "Golden Rule" for mobile sensors:
Tap [INIT]
firmly to unlock the audio hardware.
Stay Still
for the first few seconds to let the
baseline
anchor itself.
Check the Log
: If it says
SYSTEM ONLINE
, the hardware is officially talking to your code.
Would you like me to help you refine the "Hold" visual, perhaps adding a slight amber flash to the screen when a spike is captured?
